certification_blockers: All 260 absent-body operational outcomes require explicit behavior reconstruction, implementation disposition, orchestration wiring, and current acceptance evidence.
All 1,133 genuinely absent declared files require exact assignment to reconstruction cards or an evidence-backed consolidation/replacement disposition.
Release certification must be regenerated only after the reconstruction ledger has no unverified cards and all final gates are rerun.
non_claims: No byte-for-byte reconstruction is claimed for the 1,133 manifest-declared files that were absent from packs 01 through 07.
No historical validation is claimed for absent source bodies; the release relies on current clean-room canonical owners and current product tests.
